{
  "phoneNote": "The typography is calm and readable, but the oversized opening-hours chart makes visitors scroll too far before reaching the flowers and prices.",
  "desktopNote": "The restrained styling feels coherent, but oversized opening hours and generous empty bands give practical information more visual weight than the florist’s work.",

    "impression": 4,

    "hierarchy": 3,

    "spacing": 2,
    "clutter": 5,
    "distinctiveness": 4
  },
  "fixes": [
    "Replace the six large opening-hours bars with a compact day-and-time list, grouping identical weekday hours, and reduce the surrounding section padding.",
    "Lead with the bouquet image rather than the tool-covered workbench so the first screen showcases the florist’s finished work on both viewports.",
    "Place the town and street beside the hero’s directions link so visitors can identify the location without scrolling to the footer."
  ],

}
